name: two_readers_on_a_devkit
title: Two readers and a character display on a dev board
description: Modules on a board by the project that wires them
notes: The 2004 LCD is the module lcd2004_pcf8574 on the I2C bus of the board.
The PN532 modules take SPI on their I0, I1 switches.

start.notes: both PN532 read cards over SPI with these pins: 515 reads in three minutes, no errors. After the move to modules both give firmware 0x32010607 through board_bus_get with the names of the modules, and Anton saw cards read with terminal_test.
